headline: Mexican stocks lost more than 1% after the holiday
summary: The S&P/BMV IPC fell 1.15% to 70,388.96 points and the FTSE-BIVA dropped 1.06% to 1,430.70 points after a holiday. The report describes the move as a session decline following the break.
why: The S&P/BMV IPC is the benchmark index of the Mexican Stock Exchange. It reflects the performance of Mexico's largest listed companies.

impacts.name: S&P/BMV IPC
impacts.why: The benchmark index itself fell 1.15% in the session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The index fell after returning from a holiday, with the FTSE-BIVA also declining. The input gives no specific cause.
original_headline: Bolsas mexicanas perdieron más de 1% tras feriado
